headline: Ravindra Energy Limited: Rights Issue completion intimation
sum: Ravindra Energy Limited has completed its rights issue process, as per NSE intimate disclosure on 30 June 2026, indicating successful allotment and crediting of equity shares to eligible shareholders.
detail: The company filed a formal intimation with NSE on 30 June 2026 confirming completion of its rights issue subscription and allotment process. This regulatory disclosure marks the end of the offer period and transition to post-allotment crediting of shares to entitled shareholders. Rights issues remain a key capital-raise mechanism for listed companies seeking to fund expansion or debt servicing in infrastructure and energy sectors.
